validity.recommendation: Keep as a distinct row; verify StartYear1 (consider 2022 commissioning rather than 2021) and confirm SegmentCost figure.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real. P7715 is the SRG-2 Section III pipeline within Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 3 (Eastern Region Pipeline). Three INDEPENDENT non-GEM sources agree on its core identity: (1) LAIC/lamar-industrial (EPC contractor page) describes 'two 56-inch pipelines... second pipeline approximately 40 km long from BGCS #3 to KM 245.2 for SRG-2 SEC III', awarded 2015; (2) dmsprojects.net (Middle East project tracker) lists Package 3 as '150 km of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3 as well as 40 km of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2', status Completed; (3) peer-reviewed paper 'Master Gas System Phase 2 Pre-Commissioning Journey' (Mahmoud A. Younis, IJERR Vol.10 Iss.3, Sept 2022, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7072363) confirms MGS Phase 2 is ~850 km of 56" and 46" pipe built to 'transport natural gas from Eastern to Central and Western regions of Saudi Arabia'. CLASSIFICATION: CONFIRMED as dry NATURAL GAS TRANSMISSION (trunk Master Gas System), not NGL/gathering. PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are correct. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of P7714 (Shedgum-Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3). The package contains TWO distinct 56" segments: SRG-3 = ~150 km EWPS#1->BGCS#3 (= roster P7714), and SRG-2 SEC III = ~40 km BGCS#3->KM 245.2 (= this row P7715). Different lengths, different route segments along the shared Shedgum-Riyadh corridor; correctly held as separate rows. SPEC: LengthKnown=40 km AGREES with both lamar and dmsprojects (40 km SRG-2). Diameter=56" AGREES with all three sources. SPEC CAVEAT (dates): GEM StartYear1=2021 / Status=operating. The MEED ref supports a ~2021 timeframe and dmsprojects marks it 'Completed', but the IJERR paper (published Sept 2022) states the line was still in 'final construction stage of Mechanical Pre-commissioning' as of mid/late 2022, and the lamar page says the contractor's EPC scope 'Completed in 2018'. These do not contradict an operating status outright but suggest start-up may be late 2021/2022 rather than firmly 2021 -> treat StartYear1 as a soft value. SPEC CAVEAT (cost): GEM SegmentCost=$117M; lamar gives the package portion as $118.53M (close, plausibly same scope rounded); the metenders ref currently fails to verify the $117M figure and cites a ~$372M full-package budget, so the SegmentCost source is weak. EXISTING REF: the original Status ref (lamar) does not contain the literal token 'operating' (it is a contractor scope page), but it does corroborate the 40km/56"/SRG-2 identity; status is independently supported by dmsprojects 'Completed'.

fills.researcher_notes: Adds an independent non-contractor citation that the Master Gas System Phase 2 (which this segment belongs to) carries natural gas: IJERR paper states it is built 'to transport natural gas from Eastern to Central and Western regions of Saudi Arabia'. Replaces reliance on the contractor page alone for the Fuel=Gas classification.

Second independent source corroborating 56-inch diameter for the 40 km SRG-2 segment ('40 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2'), supplementing the existing lamar contractor ref.

summary: P7715 CONFIRMED (caveat): real Aramco MGS Phase-2 Pkg-3 SRG-2 Sec-III 40km/56" gas transmission line, distinct from P7714 (SRG-3, 150km); 3 independent sources agree on length/diameter/commodity; caveats on StartYear1 (likely 2021/2022, paper shows pre-commissioning in 2022) and SegmentCost ($117M vs $118.53M, weak ref).
